title: Pay transfer (stamp) duty when buying land or other dutiable property
what: Pay duty on a transfer of dutiable property (such as land) or an agreement for its sale or transfer.

sources.title: Duties Act 1999 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 7(1) (current republication (R79, from 16 December 2025; Duties Act 1999 | Acts))
sources.quote: This chapter charges duty on— (a) a transfer of dutiable property; and (b) the following transactions: (i) an agreement for the sale or transfer of dutiable property

administration.who: ACT Revenue Office (Commissioner for ACT Revenue)

assessment.summary: Pay duty on a transfer of dutiable property (such as land) or an agreement for its sale or transfer.

marks.reason: A transaction tax in the largest asset market, with an efficiency cost Treasury puts at 72 cents per extra dollar raised.
Raises the cost of moving home, so fewer people move to take better jobs.
